name: Cleaning Services Inbound Calls

hero.headline: Cleaning Services Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for cleaning services solutions.

overview: Cleaning Services Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Connect households seeking recurring house cleaning, deep cleaning and move-out cleaning with professional cleaning companies.

Consumers booking a cleaning service want to confirm availability, pricing and what is included, and many prefer to do so in a quick call rather than through an online form. Inbound Call programs place local cleaning offers in front of households searching for service and connect them directly to the company's booking team. Callers arrive ready to schedule, allowing the company to quote based on home size, secure a first appointment and present recurring options while the consumer is engaged. The channel suits companies with well-trained office staff who can close bookings on the phone.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of cleaning services consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Dual-income households, busy professionals, families with young children, older adults who need help maintaining their homes, and tenants or sellers preparing a property for handover. The most valuable segments are households seeking recurring service in larger homes, and move-out or post-renovation deep cleaning customers who can be converted to ongoing plans.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for house cleaning services near me or maid service; moving out of a rental or preparing a home for sale or new occupants; preparing for holidays, guests or a special event; recently completed a renovation and needs post-construction cleaning.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "house cleaning services near me" and "maid service near me", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard cleaning services criteria include: home located within the company's service area; type of cleaning identified as recurring, deep, move-in or move-out, or specialty; approximate home size in bedrooms, bathrooms or square footage; preferred frequency and start date stated; homeowner or tenant authorised to book service; ready to receive a quote and schedule a first cleaning.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

faq.q: Can programs prioritise recurring cleaning customers?
faq.a: Yes. Messaging can emphasise weekly and biweekly service, and screening identifies frequency preference so recurring-minded households can be prioritised.

faq.q: Do you screen out commercial cleaning requests?
faq.a: Property type is confirmed during screening, so commercial or janitorial inquiries can be excluded or routed separately if you serve both markets.

faq.q: Can move-out cleaning calls be delivered with short notice timing?
faq.a: Move-in and move-out requests are often time-sensitive, and screening captures the required date so that you can accept only those you have capacity to fulfil.
